_comment: Starter template. Mirrors the shape BaseX stores (see data_dummy/README.md). Delete fields you don't have; add fields we didn't think of — anything extra is kept under `attributes`.

entity.name: Your organisation
entity.entity_type: Nonprofit | Cooperative | Corporation | Individual | Public body
entity.description: One paragraph, shown on the entity page.

claims.submitter_name: Your name or handle (credit stays visible)
claims.claim_text: What happened, in one or two plain sentences.

attributes.anything_else: kept as-is, shown on the claim
